Linksys EA8300 WiFi Customization Guide

Router Access Basics
The default local IP address for the Linksys EA8300 is 192.168.1.1[1][2][3][5]. The standard administrative username is blank (leave empty) or admin, with default password admin[1][2][3][5][6][8].

WiFi Setup Preparation
Connect a computer to the router via Ethernet cable or WiFi (use SSID like LinksysXXXXX if default)[2]. Open a web browser and enter http://192.168.1.1. If login fails, reset router: hold reset button 15 seconds, unplug power 30 seconds, then retry[1].

Step-by-Step SSID and WPA2 Password Change
1. At 192.168.1.1 login screen, enter username (blank or admin) and password (admin). Click Sign In or continue to Linksys Smart Wi-Fi[1][5][8].
2. On dashboard, navigate to Wireless tab (or Wi-Fi Settings section)[1].
3. Select 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz band. Edit Network Name (SSID) field to your new name (e.g., MyHomeWiFi)[1].
4. Under Security, select WPA2 Personal. Enter new password (8+ characters, mix letters/numbers/symbols for strength)[1].
5. Click Apply or Save. Router reboots (1-2 minutes). Reconnect devices with new SSID/password[1].
6. Verify: Scan for new SSID, connect with new password.
